messages.message: Austria here. I propose we keep the Adriatic peaceful this year. I won't move against Venice or Rome, and I'd ask that your fleets stay out of Trieste and Albania. Let's both grow against Turkey and the neutral Balkans instead. Reply if you agree.

Austria here. I'd like to avoid conflict with you. I'm not planning moves into Galicia or Warsaw. Could you keep your armies out of Rumania and Galicia, and we can each turn toward Turkey and the Balkans?

England here. I propose peace: no one attacks anyone in 1901 and we all focus on neutral centers (NWY, DEN, HOL, BEL, SPA, POR). England will stay out of the Continent and keep to the North Sea and Atlantic. Happy to discuss a coordinated draw-leaning settlement if everyone sticks to their home waters.

France here. I propose peace: no one attacks anyone in 1901 and we all focus on neutral centers (BEL, HOL, SPA, POR, DEN, SWE, NWY, TUN). France will take SPA and BEL and stay out of the east. Germany, England, Italy: let's keep the peace in the west and talk about any moves into Burgundy or the Channel before they happen.

Germany here. I propose no early aggression between Germany and any neighbor this year. I am open to a non-aggression pact with France and Austria, and I will keep my units defensive. Russia: I am not planning to move on Warsaw or Prussia this spring; let us both focus on neutral centers like Denmark, Holland and Belgium, which I intend to contest peacefully. Happy to hear your plans.

Italy here. I propose peace: I will stay out of the Balkans and the west, focusing on Tunis and the Adriatic. Austria, let's keep our border at Venice/Tyrol quiet and both sides can grow. Anyone wanting to coordinate against a runaway power is welcome to write to me.

Russia to Turkey: I propose a peaceful spring. I will not move into Armenia or the Black Sea coast against you this year, and I expect the same from you on Sevastopol and Rumania. Let's both focus our fleets elsewhere and talk again in Fall.
Russia here. I'm open to non-aggression with any power that is not attacking me. Please reply if you want to coordinate borders; I'd rather keep the peace in the north and south while we all grow.

Turkey here. I propose peace: no power attacks another's home centers in 1901. Turkey will focus on Black Sea and Balkans (BUL, GRE, SER, RUM) and will not move against Russia's northern centers. Russia, I suggest we agree your southern border (SEV, ARM) is safe if you keep your fleet out of the Black Sea beyond SEV. Open to a DMZ over BUL/RUM. Let's all aim for a balanced board rather than an early war.

Austria here. I agree with a Balkan DMZ this year. I will not move into Serbia, Bulgaria, or Rumania, and I ask that you keep your units out of Trieste, Vienna and Budapest. If you agree, let's both focus on neutral centers and talk again in the autumn.
Austria here. Confirming my earlier message: I have no plans against Galicia or Warsaw this year. If you keep your armies out of Rumania and Galicia, I will do the same toward you.

England: I agree with the peace proposals. England's plan for 1901 is to move into the North Sea and take Norway and Holland/Belgium as neutrals open up, with no moves into the Continent heartland. France and England: I'm happy to coordinate in the Channel and North Sea, so neither of us needs to fight there. Please tell me if you plan to move into Norway or the North Sea.

France here. Proposal: I take SPA and POR with my southern fleet and army, and I will keep out of the North Sea. You take NWY, DEN and HOL. BEL is open for whoever reaches it first, so let's not fight over it this year. Reply if you agree.

Germany: agreed on a peaceful 1901. I will not attack any neighbor this spring and will move my units toward neutral centers only. Denmark is my target; I ask that no one contest DEN or HOL with me this year. Happy to share notes on borders with France, Austria and Russia in the coming seasons.

Italy here. Agreed on peace for 1901. I will move my fleet and armies toward Tunis and the Adriatic only, and will not enter Trieste, Albania or the Balkans. Austria, I will keep Venice and Rome defensive. Let's both aim for neutral centers and avoid early conflict.

Russia to Austria: Agreed for 1901. I will not move into Galicia or Rumania this spring, and my armies in Warsaw will stay out of Galicia. Please do the same toward Warsaw and Ukraine, and let's both turn toward Turkey and the Balkans.

Russia to Turkey: I accept a DMZ over Rumania and Bulgaria for 1901. My fleet at Sevastopol will not enter the Black Sea beyond its own waters, and I will not attack Armenia or Ankara this year. Please keep your fleets out of Sevastopol and the northern Black Sea coast.

Turkey to Russia: agreed on a peaceful spring. I will not move into Sevastopol or Armenia this year. Turkey's fleet stays in the Black Sea and my armies head to Bulgaria and Greece. If you keep out of Rumania, we can both grow and talk again in Fall.

Turkey: I support a peaceful 1901. Turkey will take BUL, GRE, SER and RUM in the south-east and will not attack any neighbor's home centers this year. Let's keep the early game calm and reassess in Fall.

ENGLAND: F NTH C A YOR - BEL

messages.message: Austria to Turkey: you took Bulgaria while I held back, so I am moving into Serbia this fall. I will not go into Rumania, and I'd like to keep our border at Serbia/Bulgaria settled from here. Please keep your units out of Trieste and Vienna, and let's discuss the autumn borders.
Austria to Russia: I am keeping my units out of Galicia and Rumania this fall, and I expect the same from you. Let's keep the north calm.

England here. Fall 1901: I intend to take NWY with my fleet and move toward HOL/BEL as neutrals are contested. Germany, you have DEN and HOL in reach; I will not contest DEN with you this turn. France, I will not enter the Mid-Atlantic or Spain; keep to SPA/POR as agreed. Please say if you plan to fight over NWY or BEL so we can avoid bounces.

France here. Quick check-in: Germany moved F KIE to DEN and A MUN to RUH, which puts pressure on Burgundy and Belgium. I'm holding Paris and will not enter Germany. England, you moved into the North Sea as agreed; I'm taking Portugal and Spain this Fall, and I will not enter the North Sea or Norway. Russia and Turkey: no moves from me toward your home centers. Let's keep the peace and compare notes before Spring 1902.

Germany here. Denmark is taken by us this year and I have no plans to move further into the west. I am looking at Holland and Belgium as neutral centers for 1902. France and England: if either of you is moving on Belgium or Holland this fall, please tell me now so we avoid a bounce. I am willing to commit to a fall non-aggression pact with anyone who keeps out of Berlin, Kiel and Munich, and I will not move into Burgundy or Silesia against any power that stays out of my home centers.

Italy here. Good to see peace hold in 1901. I plan to take neutral Tunis (TUN) and Greece/Apulia-area neutrals this Fall without touching any power's home centers. Austria: I am keeping Venice and Rome defensive, and I'd like to hear your Fall plans. Turkey: if you take Greece or Serbia, I will not contest them. Let's keep the neutral centers as the race and avoid early war.

Russia to Germany: I am moving my fleet from Bothnia to Sweden this Fall as a neutral center. Please keep your fleet on Denmark and Holland, and let's keep Russia and Germany out of each other's home centers. I have no plans against Warsaw or Prussia while you honor that.

Russia to Turkey: I see your fleet moved into the Black Sea and your army into Bulgaria. Our agreement was no Turkish fleet attack on Sevastopol. My fleet at Sevastopol will hold this Fall and I expect you to keep your fleet out of Sevastopol and Armenia. I will not enter Rumania or Bulgaria.
Turkey to Italy: your fleet is in the Ionian Sea. I plan to take Greece this Fall and ask that you stay out of GRE and the Balkans, as agreed. In return Turkey will not contest Tunis or the Adriatic.

Turkey to Austria: I hold BUL and will move on SER and RUM this autumn if they are open. I suggest we coordinate: Austria takes SER and I take RUM and GRE, or we both keep our units out of each other's targets. Please reply.
Turkey to Russia: I intend to take RUM this Fall. Please keep SEV and the Black Sea fleet out of the south, and we can discuss a fair border in 1902.

Austria to Turkey: agreed. I take SER this fall and will not move into RUM or GRE. You take RUM and GRE. I will keep my units out of Bulgaria and Rumania and will not move toward Constantinople or Smyrna. Please keep your units out of Trieste and Vienna.

England here. Fall 1901: my fleet is taking Norway (NTH-NWY support from NWG) and my army at York goes to Holland or Belgium as neutrals allow. Germany: I will not contest Denmark or Holland with you if you stay out of Norway, Edinburgh and London. France: I will keep out of Spain and Portugal, and I ask that you keep out of the North Sea. Let's keep every neutral center a fair race.

France: I'm taking SPA and POR this Fall with A SPA and F MAO. I will not enter BEL, HOL, DEN or NWY, and I will not enter the North Sea. Germany and England: no bounce needed, keep to your stated targets. Italy: Tunis is fine by me. Austria, Russia, Turkey: I'm staying out of your home centers, and I'd welcome the same from you.

Germany: Holland and Belgium are my Fall targets. A RUH is moving to HOL and A BER holds. England: please do not move into HOL or BEL this fall; if you go for Norway, I will not contest it. Russia: thanks for choosing Sweden, I will keep the Baltic and Denmark quiet and will not move on Warsaw or Prussia. France: I am not moving toward Burgundy or Paris this Fall. Let's all report any surprises before Spring 1902.

Italy to Turkey: agreed. I will not enter Greece this Fall. My fleet in the Ionian will go to Tunis, and I will not contest Greece, Serbia or the Balkans. Please keep your fleets out of the Adriatic and Tunis.

Russia to Turkey: Rumania was in our agreed DMZ for 1901, and I expect it to stay that way. If your army moves into Rumania or your fleet moves on Sevastopol this Fall, I will treat it as a breach and respond. If you hold to the DMZ, I will keep my Sevastopol fleet at home and we can discuss a clear border for 1902.

Russia to Germany: Thank you for keeping your fleet on Denmark. I am moving to Sweden as a neutral center and have no plans against Prussia, Silesia or Warsaw while you stay out of Moscow and Warsaw. Let's keep our border calm and both take neutrals in 1902.

Turkey to Austria: fair enough. I will not enter Serbia this Fall. I will take Rumania and Greece, and keep my units out of Trieste, Vienna and Budapest. Let's keep our border Serbia/Bulgaria settled and talk in 1902.
Turkey to Russia: my fleet in the Black Sea is not attacking Sevastopol this Fall. I intend to move on Rumania only. Keep your fleet at SEV and we will have no conflict in the south this year.

Austria here. I hold 4 centers (BUD, SER, TRI, VIE) and I intend to build an army in Budapest this winter. I have kept every promise made this year and I'm asking all powers to keep to their word in 1902. Turkey: I expect you to stay out of Trieste, Vienna and Serbia. Russia: I expect you to stay out of Galicia and Rumania. Let's use the neutral centers, Rumania and Bulgaria, as the open race and avoid a three-way war over Austria's homeland.

England here. Fall 1901 went through: we hold BEL and NWY alongside EDI, LON, LVP. Germany, you hold HOL and DEN; I'm not contesting those. I plan to build a fleet or army in Winter and hold the North Sea and Belgium. Let's keep the 1902 neutrals (SWE, DEN, HOL, SPA, POR, TUN, GRE, BUL, RUM, SER) on a clear, non-bouncing basis, and let's talk before any Spring moves.

France here. I now hold BRE, MAR, PAR, POR and SPA, and I plan to build one army this Winter to hold the Channel and Burgundy. I'm not moving toward Belgium, Holland, Germany or the North Sea, and I'd like everyone to keep to the same understanding in 1902. Germany and England: if either of you wants to coordinate on Belgium or Holland next Spring, tell me now.

Germany here. Congratulations to England, France and Russia on your gains, and thanks for keeping 1901 peaceful. I have five centers and will build for defense and for the 1902 neutral race. I have no plans against any power this winter. Please tell me now if you intend any move against Germany's home centers or Holland, Denmark or Belgium in 1902, so we can settle borders before Spring.

Italy here. Congratulations to all on a peaceful 1901. Italy now holds Tunis and will build a fleet or army at Naples. I remain committed to peace with everyone and will not attack any neighbor. Austria, I hope we keep the Adriatic calm in 1902.

Russia here. Congratulations on a calm 1901. Russia will build a fleet at St. Petersburg this winter for the northern and Baltic seas. I remain committed to no attacks on any power that keeps out of Moscow, Warsaw and Sevastopol. Turkey: Rumania and Bulgaria are open neutrals; I ask that we keep to the DMZ and talk before any move on Sevastopol. Let's keep the race for neutrals peaceful.

Turkey to Russia: I kept my word in Fall 1901 and did not enter Rumania or attack Sevastopol. I will keep to that DMZ in 1902 if you keep your fleets out of the Black Sea and Greece. Let's set a clear border: Rumania neutral, Sevastopol and Armenia yours, Constantinople and Smyrna mine. Please confirm.

Turkey: Winter 1901 is a build phase for me. I hold 4 centers (ANK, CON, GRE, SMY) and I intend to build in CON and ANK to defend the Black Sea and the Balkans. I remain open to peace with all powers and will not attack any power's home centers this year.

Austria here. I'm building in Budapest this winter for defense. Turkey and Russia: I will not move into Rumania or Bulgaria in 1902 if you both stay out of Trieste, Vienna, Budapest and Serbia. I'd welcome a clear Balkan settlement before Spring so we avoid bounces.

England: I'll build an army in London (or a fleet if needed) to hold the Channel and North Sea. Thanks all for a peaceful 1901. Still open to coordinated neutral-center races in 1902; I will not attack any power that keeps out of England's home centers and Belgium/Norway.

France: confirming my plan. I hold 5 centers and will build one army in Paris or Marseille to guard Burgundy and the Channel. I will not attack anyone in 1902 and I ask for the same. Neutral race targets I see as open: BUL, RUM, TUN is taken, BEL and HOL are contested by England and Germany, so let's settle those in Spring diplomacy rather than by force.

Germany: I will build in Kiel/Munich for defense this winter and keep my armies home. I am not planning any attack in 1902 on any power that stays out of Berlin, Kiel, Munich, Denmark and Holland. England, France: thanks for the clear statements on Belgium and Holland; I am not contesting them further. Let's keep Spring 1902 moves to neutrals only and report any surprise immediately.

Italy here. Agreed: I will build at Naples this winter for defense and will not attack anyone. I am keeping Venice and Rome defensive toward Austria and will not enter Trieste, Albania or the Balkans. Let's keep the 1902 neutral race peaceful.

Russia to Turkey: Confirmed. Rumania and Bulgaria are neutral, Sevastopol and Armenia are Russian, Constantinople and Smyrna are Turkish. My fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Greece, and I will not enter Rumania or Bulgaria in 1902 if your armies stay out of Sevastopol and Armenia.
Russia to Austria: Confirmed, I will keep out of Galicia and Rumania. Please do the same toward Warsaw and Ukraine.
Turkey to Russia: I confirm the border: Rumania neutral, Sevastopol and Armenia yours, Constantinople and Smyrna mine. I will not move into Rumania or attack Sevastopol in 1902 unless you do first.

TURKEY: A GRE S A CON - BUL
F BLA S A CON - BUL

messages.message: Austria here. Spring 1902: I hold BUD, SER, TRI, VIE and I'm keeping my homeland defended. My plan is to take the open neutrals Rumania and Bulgaria only if no other power contests them. Turkey: you hold GRE and CON; please confirm you will not move into Serbia, Bulgaria or Rumania this Spring, and I'll do the same toward your home centers. Russia: please confirm you stay out of Galicia. Italy: I expect no moves into Trieste or Albania. Let's post our Spring orders publicly so nobody bounces by accident.

England here, Spring 1902. I hold BEL, NWY, EDI, LON, LVP and have no plans against any power this spring. Germany: I'm not moving into HOL or DEN; please keep Belgium and Holland out of your Spring orders since my fleet and army are staying put. Russia: I'm not moving on Sweden or the Baltic. France: I'll keep out of Spain, Portugal and Burgundy. Let's keep this a peaceful year and talk before anyone moves on a neutral.

France here. Spring 1902: I'm holding my current centers and will not move into Belgium, Holland, Germany, the North Sea or Italy. My only moves are internal consolidation in Iberia and Burgundy. Germany: I see A MUN and A BER near Burgundy; I will hold Burgundy and Paris defensively and ask you to do the same. England: BEL is yours, I won't contest it. Russia, Turkey, Austria, Italy: no French moves toward your homelands. Let's report any surprises immediately.

Germany here. Spring 1902: I am holding Holland, Denmark, Kiel, Munich and Berlin and have no attack planned on anyone. England: Belgium is currently yours, and I will not move on it. Neutral centers left are Bulgaria, Rumania, Sweden (Russia holds it now), Norway (England holds it) and Spain/Portugal (France). Let's each keep to the neutral race and report any move toward a home center immediately. I suggest a clear settlement: no one enters Germany, England or Russia home centers, and we settle Rumania/Bulgaria between Austria, Russia and Turkey without bounces.

Italy here. Spring 1902: I have no plans against any power. My units in Naples, Rome, Venice and Tunis will stay put or hold neutral ground. Austria, I see you have three units near Serbia and Trieste; I ask you to keep your fleet and armies out of Venice and Rome and I will do the same. Open to a clear settlement on Rumania and Bulgaria, which are neutral and open to all.

Russia here. Spring 1902: I am holding my core and have no attacks planned. Russia's fleets will take the neutral Baltic and Scandinavian centers (FIN, and possibly DEN or NWY if they open) and will not enter the Black Sea or Rumania. Austria, Turkey: please confirm you are keeping to our Rumania/Galicia understandings. Germany: I expect no moves on Warsaw, Moscow or Sweden. Let's report any surprises before Fall.

Turkey here for Spring 1902. I hold ANK, CON, GRE, SMY and will move to take BUL this Spring as a neutral center; I will not enter Rumania, Serbia, Albania or any home center. Austria: Serbia is yours, I will not contest it. Russia: I expect you to keep to our DMZ over RUM and keep fleets out of the Black Sea. Anyone else taking a neutral in 1902, tell me now so we avoid bounces.

Austria here, round 2 for Spring 1902. I will move A BUD to RUM this Spring as the only neutral I contest; no unit of mine goes to Bulgaria, Galicia, Venice, Rome or any home center. Turkey: you said you will take BUL, which I will not contest, so we are clear. Russia: I am not entering Galicia or Warsaw. Italy: nothing of mine goes near Trieste-Venice-Rome. Please keep this public so there are no bounces.

England, Spring 1902 round 2: I hold BEL, NWY, EDI, LON, LVP and my units are holding this spring. No English move into HOL, DEN, SWE or the Continent. Germany: thanks for confirming you will not attack Belgium; I hold it and will not move toward you. Russia: I will stay out of the Baltic. Let's keep 1902 peaceful and talk before Fall about any neutral centers still open.

France, round 2: I'm holding Iberia and Burgundy this Spring and making no moves into Belgium, Holland, Germany, the North Sea or Italy. I will take no neutral this Spring. Turkey, Austria and Russia: since Rumania and Bulgaria are open, let's each post our intended neutral targets now so nobody bounces. I'm staying out of the Balkans entirely.

Germany, round 2: I confirm I am holding this Spring: no moves into Belgium, Norway, Sweden, Burgundy or any home center. My units stay in Berlin, Kiel, Munich, Denmark and Holland. Turkey: Bulgaria is yours if you take it; I will not contest it. Austria and Russia: Rumania is open, and I will not move there. Let's report any surprise before Fall 1902.

Italy here, Spring 1902. I am holding Naples, Rome, Venice and Tunis and have no moves against anyone this spring. I will not enter Trieste, Albania, Serbia, Greece, Bulgaria or Rumania. Austria and Turkey: since you both want Bulgaria or Rumania, please settle it between yourselves without bounces. Italy will report any change in plans before Fall.

Russia, round 2 of Spring 1902: confirming no Russian moves into Galicia, Rumania, Bulgaria, Prussia, Silesia or the Black Sea this Spring. My fleets are heading for neutral Scandinavia and the Baltic only. Turkey: I will not enter Bulgaria or Rumania; you take Bulgaria as you said. Austria: please keep Galicia and Warsaw as agreed.

Turkey, round 2: I confirm Spring 1902 moves: my armies at CON and GRE take Bulgaria (BUL) as a neutral center. No Turkish moves into Rumania, Serbia, Albania or any home center. Austria: I will not contest Serbia. Russia: I am keeping to the Rumania DMZ and the Black Sea closed to your fleets. Please reply if anyone plans to move into BUL so we avoid a bounce.

Austria to Turkey: you now hold BUL and I hold RUM and SER with my units staying put this Fall. I expect no Turkish move into Serbia, Rumania or Trieste. In return I am making no move toward Bulgaria, Greece or Constantinople. Please confirm that you will keep to this in Spring 1903.

Austria to Russia: I have taken RUM as a neutral and I am holding it. Please keep your armies out of Galicia and Rumania, and tell me your Spring 1903 plans so we avoid a bounce around Warsaw and Ukraine.

Austria here, Fall 1902. Our neutral race has closed for now: Turkey holds BUL and Austria holds RUM, SER, BUD, TRI, VIE. I will not attack any power in 1903 that keeps out of my home centers. Anyone planning an attack on Austria, tell me now. Otherwise, let's settle the remaining neutrals (SWE, DEN, HOL, SPA, POR, TUN, GRE and BEL) with no bounces.

England, Fall 1902: I hold BEL, NWY, EDI, LON, LVP and plan to stay put this Fall with no moves against any power. Germany: I am not moving on HOL or DEN; please keep Belgium out of your orders. Russia: I will not enter the Baltic. Let's post Fall orders publicly so nobody bounces by accident, and let's agree a draw-leaning settlement if the neutral race stalls.

France, Fall 1902: I hold BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA and will make no moves this Fall. Turkey took Bulgaria and Austria took Rumania, so the neutral race is closed for now. Since every power has held its centers, I propose we all keep home positions in Fall 1902 and talk before 1903. Any power planning a move into a home center or an unexpected neutral, please tell us now.

Germany, Fall 1902: I hold BER, DEN, HOL, KIE, MUN and have no attack planned. The neutral centers are now all taken (BUL, RUM are owned), so the board is set for a while. Since growth is hard for everyone, I propose we discuss a draw once the map stabilizes. Anyone planning a move into a German home center or into Holland/Denmark this fall, please say so now. I will hold my units this Fall.

Italy here, Fall 1902. Turkey took Bulgaria and Austria took Rumania, so the neutral race is largely settled. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and has no moves against anyone this Fall. Any remaining neutrals (Greece and Serbia are taken; Albania is empty) are open to discussion, but I will not enter Austrian or Turkish homelands. Let's keep the peace and report any surprises before Spring 1903.

Russia here, Fall 1902. Thanks for a quiet Spring. Austria took RUM, Turkey took BUL, and Russia took FIN with no bounces. I hold MOS, WAR, SEV, SWE, FIN and have no planned attacks on anyone this Fall. My fleets stay in the Baltic and Gulf of Bothnia. Germany, England: please keep to your current holdings. Austria, Turkey: please keep Rumania and Bulgaria as already settled, and no fleet entries into the Black Sea. Let's report any surprises before Spring 1903.

Turkey to Austria: you moved A BUD to RUM in Spring, and I did not contest it. Rumania is now yours in practice. I hold BUL and GRE, and I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Let's keep the Balkans settled: Austria holds RUM and SER, Turkey holds BUL and GRE, and neither of us attacks the other this Fall. Please confirm.

Turkey to Russia: I hold BUL and will keep the Black Sea closed to Russian fleets. Please keep SEV and your fleet out of the south. I have no plans against your home centers; let's keep the DMZ and talk about 1903.
Austria to Turkey: confirmed. Austria holds RUM and SER, Turkey holds BUL and GRE, and neither of us attacks the other in Fall 1902 or Spring 1903 while both keep out of each other's home centers.

England, Fall 1902 round 2: I hold BEL, NWY, EDI, LON, LVP and am staying put this Fall. No English moves toward any power. Agreed that the neutral race is closed for now. I support a draw-leaning settlement once the map stabilizes, and I ask everyone to keep home positions through 1903 and report any surprises immediately.

France, round 2 Fall 1902: I confirm no French moves this Fall. I hold BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA. Everyone has held their centers, so the board is set for now. I'm open to a draw once the map stabilizes, but I'd like to see any power's Spring 1903 plans first, so we avoid surprises.

Germany, Fall 1902 round 2: I confirm I am holding all five centers (BER, DEN, HOL, KIE, MUN) with no moves this Fall and no plans against any power. Since the neutral race is closed, I agree we should move toward a draw-leaning settlement and keep every home center fixed. Let's each post Fall 1902 orders publicly and avoid any unexpected moves in 1903.

Italy here, Fall 1902 round 2. I confirm no Italian moves this Fall and no entry into any home center. Board is largely set, so I agree that a draw is reasonable once centers stabilize. I will keep Naples, Rome, Venice and Tunis defensive and expect the same from everyone.

Russia, Fall 1902 round 2: Agreed the neutral race is closed for now. Russia holds MOS, WAR, SEV, SWE, FIN and will make no attacks this Fall. Austria and Turkey: Rumania and Bulgaria are settled, and I will keep my fleets out of the Black Sea. Germany and England: I will not enter Denmark, Holland, Belgium or Norway. Let's keep Fall orders public and avoid bounces, and talk about any Spring 1903 neutral moves before Spring.

Turkey, Fall 1902 round 2: I confirm I am holding BUL, GRE, ANK, CON, SMY and making no moves into Serbia, Rumania, Albania or any home center. Austria: I accept the Balkan settlement, RUM and SER yours, BUL and GRE mine. Russia: Black Sea stays closed to your fleets; no Turkish moves toward SEV or ARM. I agree with keeping home positions this Fall and reviewing before Spring 1903.

Austria here, Winter 1902. I hold BUD, RUM, SER, TRI, VIE and am building A BUD for defense. Since every power now has 4 to 5 centers and nobody can reach a solo soon, I am willing to accept a draw. I voted no last phase only to see Spring 1903 moves first. If all surviving powers keep home positions in Spring 1903 with no bounces or attacks, I will vote yes in the next movement phase.

England, Winter 1902: Austria voted no on the draw, so I'd like to know why. Everyone else has held centers, and no unowned centers remain. England will build one army at Liverpool for defense and stay out of the Continent. I still favor a draw vote at the next opportunity if nobody moves in Spring 1903. Austria, please say what would make you vote yes. Anyone planning a Spring 1903 move on a home center, please say so now.

France, Winter 1902: Austria did not vote for the draw. Austria, what is your objection and what are your 1903 plans? Everyone else voted yes, so if you're open to it, a draw now would lock in the current board. France holds BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA and will build only if forced by the rules. I'm asking everyone to restate their intent to hold in 1903 so we can settle a draw next Fall.

Germany, Winter 1902: Six of seven powers voted yes on the draw last phase; Austria voted no. Austria, what would make you accept a draw? With no neutrals left, growth now requires attacking a neighbour, which risks everyone's centers. I am willing to keep all home centers fixed in 1903 and vote yes again if the rest of the board does the same. Please post any objections before Spring 1903.

Italy here, Winter 1902. Austria did not vote for the draw. Austria, can you confirm your Spring 1903 intentions? Italy has no moves planned and would vote for a draw again if every power agrees. Since no neutral centers remain, growth can only come at someone's expense, so let's keep the peace and settle the draw.

Russia, Winter 1902: The draw vote failed because Austria voted no. Austria, what would you need to accept a draw? All neutrals are now owned, so any further growth means attacking a neighbor, which would hurt everyone's share. Russia will keep its five centers and not attack in 1903 if others do the same. Let's all vote draw again in Spring 1903 unless someone announces a concrete plan.

Turkey, Winter 1902: Austria did not vote for the draw, so the game continues. Turkey holds ANK, BUL, CON, GRE, SMY and will build one unit at CON for defense. I still favor a draw once the map is stable, and I ask Austria what its Spring 1903 plans are. Turkey will keep the Balkan settlement and the Black Sea closed.

Austria, Winter 1902 round 2: I confirm Austria will hold all five centers (BUD, RUM, SER, TRI, VIE) in Spring 1903 with no moves into any power's home center or any neutral. I will vote yes on the draw in the Spring 1903 movement phase if every other power also holds home positions and does not move on a neighbour in Spring. Please post any Spring 1903 plans now so we can avoid surprises.

England, Winter 1902 round 2: Thanks Austria for clarifying. I agree: if all powers hold home centers in Spring 1903 with no attacks, we vote draw in the next movement phase. England will hold BEL, NWY, EDI, LON, LVP and stays out of the Continent. Please everyone confirm the same.

France, Winter 1902 round 2: I confirm France holds BRE, MAR, PAR, POR, SPA and will make no Spring 1903 moves into any power's home center. I will vote yes on the draw in the next movement phase if everyone else holds. Austria: if you are willing to keep home positions in Spring 1903, please say so and we can close this game as a draw.

Germany, Winter 1902 round 2: Austria, you have now said you will accept a draw if all keep home positions in Spring 1903. I confirm Germany will hold BER, DEN, HOL, KIE and MUN with no moves in 1903 and will vote yes in the next movement phase. Everyone: let's all hold in Spring 1903 and vote draw then.

Italy here, Winter 1902 round 2. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will keep all four fixed in Spring 1903 with no moves. I will vote yes on a draw in the next movement phase if all others do. Austria, if you vote yes too, the game ends now-equivalent in peace.

Russia, Winter 1902 round 2: Austria, thank you for saying you will accept a draw if everyone holds in Spring 1903. Russia commits to holding MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, SWE and FIN with no attacks in 1903 and will vote yes in the next movement phase. Everyone else, please do the same so we can end the game with the current six-way-plus-one board.

Turkey, Winter 1902 round 2: I confirm Turkey holds ANK, BUL, CON, GRE, SMY and will hold all positions in Spring 1903 with no attacks on any power. I will vote yes on a draw in the next movement phase if the other powers keep home positions. Austria: your Balkan holdings RUM and SER are recognized by Turkey; please confirm you will not move toward BUL, GRE or CON in 1903.
